newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Micron Electronics buy reiterated.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Micron Electronics buy reiterated.

text.p: Rodman & Renshaw Inc analyst Brian Angerame on Wednesday reiterated a buy recommendation for Micron Electronics Inc.

-He maintained his fiscal fourth quarter 1997, fiscal 1997 and fiscal 1998 earnings estimates of $0.21, $0.98, and $1.45 per share, respectively. The fourth-quarter and fiscal 1997 estimates are operating results and do not include $0.03 per share dilution estimated from buying NetFRAME Systems Inc.
-After discussions with Micron management, Angerame said he is "confident" the company is on track to meet or possibly exceed his $0.21 fourth fiscal quarter 1997 estimate.

"While the strike at UPS has raised some concern among investors in the direct channel PC suppliers, we are not concerned about MUEI's business, as over 90 percent of its shipments are carried by Federal Express," Angerame wrote in a research note. -- ((Reuters Chicago Newsdesk (312) 408-8787))
